description: This file defines utility functions, type casting, tensor creation helpers, and lazy tensor management for the AOT Triton adapter in a ROCm (HIP) environment, specifically for transformer models within the ATen library.

classes.name: LazyTensorContext
classes.description: Context structure for managing lazy tensor creation and reuse, holding tensors and their associated metadata.

classes.name: LazyTensorFunctions
classes.description: Template struct providing acquire and dispose methods for lazy tensor management, specialized by tensor rank and zero-initialization requirement.

methods.name: cast_dtype
methods.description: Converts a Caffe2 TypeMeta dtype to an internal AOT Triton DType.

methods.name: mk_aotensor
methods.description: Creates an AOT Triton tensor view from a PyTorch tensor, with rank validation.

methods.name: mk_aoscalartensor
methods.description: Creates a scalar AOT Triton tensor view from a PyTorch tensor.

methods.name: mk_philoxtensor
methods.description: Creates a scalar AOT Triton tensor view from a pointer to uint64 data.

methods.name: mk_atomictensor
methods.description: Creates a scalar AOT Triton tensor view from a pointer to int32 data.

methods.name: mklazy_common
methods.description: Creates a lazy tensor object with specified rank and zero-initialization behavior.

methods.name: mklazy_empty_like
methods.description: Creates a lazy tensor that is an empty-like tensor, not keeping original strides.

methods.name: mklazy_fp32zeros
methods.description: Creates a lazy tensor initialized with zeros, not keeping original strides.
